Shah Rukh Khan's 'King' releases first song 'Tu Mil Jaaye' featuring Deepika Padukone

The first song from the upcoming film 'King', titled 'Tu Mil Jaaye', has been released. The track features actors Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone. Netizens have noted similarities between the song and previous Shah Rukh Khan films like 'Pathaan' and 'Jawan'. The song was released on Shah Rukh Khan's 61st birthday and hints at a tragic twist.
